correctness.rationale: For distinct triples, direct complement-based graph reasoning gives distances 1,2,3 exactly when intersections are 0,2,1, respectively. Exact independent construction of the 35-vertex square graph and exhaustive maximal-clique enumeration gives 56 five-vertex facets and f=(35,280,560,280,56). The deterministic two-stage free-face sequence removes 56 dimension (3,4) pairs and 224 (2,3) pairs, all verified to be currently free; the remaining 2-complex has 35 vertices, 280 edges, 336 triangles. An explicit spanning-tree basis of 246 edge cycles yields a signed integer matrix of shape 246×336. Independent reconstruction and exact Hermite normal form gave a full-rank lattice with 245 unit diagonal factors and one factor 2, so H1≅Z/2 rather than merely mod-2 evidence. H2 is a free kernel of rank 336−246=90; no higher homology after collapses. Scale 1 is triangle-free connected graph with 70 edges so H1=Z^36; the general clique-graph-power π1 surjectivity theorem makes the nontrivial order-2 class persist from scale one, while scale three is a simplex. The H2(F2) dimension 91 follows by universal coefficients. This is a complete finite exact calculation, not inference from sampled graphs.
